name: jyu_hip_right
desc: Same character, same size, same colors and cream pattern, still facing the viewer with both hands on his hips. The head and face stay exactly the same: the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes looking down with a heavy smug gaze. Change only the body: he twists and thrusts his hips strongly out to the right side of the picture in a sultry hip sway, the pelvis and the big belly shifted far to the right, the weight on the right leg, while the chest and shoulders tilt the other way to the left to balance, the body forming a curved S shape. Thick paint dripping. Same outline and pixel art style.
